role: FitnessSummaryCards extension holding the workout post-summary cards: physiology (decoupling/EF), conditions/heat, splits, route-history baseline, coach report, save-to-route-library, export, DEM elevation recompute, α1 re-analysis and recap-card share, plus archive write-back helpers.
types: FitnessSummaryCards.RouteHistorySummary: struct — prior-run count + pace/HR comparison rows
toplevel: File-scope private helpers: routeHistoryHeader and routeHistoryValues (@MainActor views), and formatTemp, heatContributionLine and rebuildAnalysisSnapshot (pure, kept outside FitnessSummaryCards). All state lives in FitnessSummaryCards' @Binding properties declared in FitnessSummaryCards.swift. RouteBaseline, which routeHistorySummary builds, is in RouteBaseline.swift.

units.does: Card with a 'Physiology' header, the decoupling row, the efficiency-factor row and an empty-state note.
Shows 'Needs more time + distance to compute drift metrics.' when the workout has neither decoupling nor EF.

branches.effect: shows the note; otherwise renders nothing

units.does: Headline row 'Efficiency Factor' with EF to 2 decimals and caption 'normalized pace ÷ avg HR', only when EF exists.
Headline row 'Pa:Hr Decoupling' as signed percent with caption 'strong aerobic efficiency' below 5% else 'efficiency drifted', only when decoupling exists.

branches.effect: 'strong aerobic efficiency' (also for any negative value); >= 5 → 'efficiency drifted'

flags.text: Any decoupling below 5% — including large negative values such as -20%, which indicate HR falling relative to pace or bad data — is labelled 'strong aerobic efficiency'.

units.does: When the workout has a weather snapshot, computes heat exposure and session heat stimulus and renders environmentBody with the temperature unit from the injected settingsManager; otherwise nothing.
'Conditions' card: temperature headline with humidity/conditions caption, heat-stimulus sentence and MET Norway attribution when applicable.
Returns '<humidity>% humidity', prefixed by the localized conditions text when the snapshot has conditions.

branches.effect: return humidity-only caption; else 'conditions, N% humidity'

units.does: Shows 'Weather data: MET Norway (CC BY 4.0)' only when the snapshot has wind (i.e. was fetched from MET Norway, not Apple Health).
'Splits' card listing splitRow for each resolved split with 'mi' or 'km' unit label.
Renders the route-history body when the workout has a non-empty recognized route name and the async-loaded routeHistory summary is non-nil; otherwise nothing (including while loading).

branches.cond: route name present & non-empty and routeHistory non-nil

units.does: Card with route header ('On <route>', 'vs your last N') and pace/HR comparison rows when present.
Row with a label and a trailing today/baseline pair plus the delta caption (tertiary colour).

Finds prior runs on the same named route, returns nil when there are none, otherwise builds a RouteHistorySummary with prior count and pace/HR comparison rows against the RouteBaseline aggregated over those runs.

Lazily walks archive entries (newest first) of type workout other than this session, decodes each with retrieveLightweight (errors dropped), keeps those whose recognizedRouteName equals the name, stops after 20 matches and returns them newest first.

flags.text: Decodes (and decrypts) archived workout files to filter by route name on each post-summary open and archive change, because the route name is not in the index entry; the walk stops after 20 matches, but a route with fewer than 20 prior runs still decodes the whole workout history.

units.does: When baseline and today both exceed 100 m (and today > 60 s), computes today's and the baseline's sec/km from elapsed duration/distance and returns formatted paces with a delta caption; nil otherwise.

branches.cond: baseline distance <= 100, today distance missing/<=100 or duration missing/<=60

units.does: Converts the sec/km delta to sec/mi for imperial and words it as 'N s/mi|km faster|slower than usual'.

When the baseline has HR, computes today's mean of positive sample HRs (falling back to session.meanHR from the analysis result) and returns today/baseline bpm with a delta caption; nil when no baseline HR or no today HR.

branches.effect: fallback to session.meanHR (analysisResult.timeDomain.meanHR); else sample mean

units.does: Formats bpm as localized 'N bpm' (rounded).
Words an HR delta as 'N bpm lower than usual' when negative, else 'N bpm higher than usual'.
Coach Report card: header, description and the Generate & Email button.
Button that calls WorkoutRecorder.scheduleCoachReportEmail(for: session) to generate the coach report and stage the email composer.

flags.text: The button has no in-flight or disabled state; every tap calls scheduleCoachReportEmail, which starts a new detached multi-page PDF render and stages another email, so repeated taps produce repeated renders/composers.

units.does: Shows the save-route body only when the workout has a GPS polyline.
Card with the route-library header and state, plus a 'Name this route' alert with a text field bound to newRouteName whose Save calls commitSavedRoute.
units.entry: SwiftUI view builder; alert presented when showSaveRouteSheet binding is true

units.does: If this session's saved route id resolves to a route in the store, shows 'Saved as "name"…'; otherwise shows the save explanation and the Add button.

branches.cond: savedRouteIDForThisSession set and found in savedRouteStore.routes
branches.effect: confirmation text; else explanation + Add to my route library button

flags.text: The explanation says 'Save this walk…including any out-and-back you did mid-walk' for every GPS sport (runs, rides), since the card is shown for any workout with a polyline.

units.does: Button that pre-fills newRouteName with defaultSavedRouteName() and presents the naming alert.
Header row with map icon and 'Route library'.
Returns '<sport localized name> <count of saved routes with that sport + 1>', e.g. 'Run 3'.
Trims the entered name (blank → defaultSavedRouteName()); if SavedRoute.from(session:) succeeds, adds it to the store, records its id for this session and starts background road-name enrichment.

branches.effect: saves under the default '<sport> N' name
return silently: no route saved and no error shown

flags.text: A session SavedRoute.from cannot convert (polyline decodes to fewer than two points) closes the alert with nothing saved and no message. (A blank name now falls back to the default name.)

units.does: Export card: header with progress spinner, recap-card share, PDF share, GPX/CSV/TCX share rows and an error note.
Shows exportError in red when set.
TCX share row (TrainingPeaks, Final Surge, Garmin Connect) for tcxURL.
CSV share row (Numbers, Excel, Google Sheets) for csvURL.
GPX share row (Strava, Garmin Connect, WorkOutDoors, Dropbox) for gpxURL.
'Export' header with a small spinner while exports are not ready.
Shows the DEM elevation-recompute card only when the workout has a GPS track.
Card explaining the OpenTopoData lookup (current stored gain, 10 m US / 30 m elsewhere, 15 m sustained climbs, up to 100 points rounded ~11 m sent off-device), with preview, error and action button.

branches.effect: ?? 0 → copy says 'Current: 0 ft/m' even when no elevation was ever recorded

units.does: Button that runs runResmoothElevation in a Task; label 'Querying map & saving…' and dimmed/disabled while running.

branches.effect: label 'Querying map & saving…'; else 'Look up and save real elevation'

units.does: Shows elevResmoothError in red when set.
Shows 'Map-derived: X gain · Y loss' when a preview exists.
Header 'Recompute elevation (topo map)' with spinner while running.

Sets the busy flag, queries TopoElevationService.elevations(for: track, maxSamples: 100) (OpenTopoData), stores the gain/loss preview and saves it to the archive; maps service errors to a translated message and other errors to their localizedDescription.

Runs SessionArchive.update(id) (which re-archives under the archive lock, stamps modifiedAt and requests a CloudKit re-upload) applying change and capturing the stored result; returns nil when the archive throws fileNotFound, rethrows other errors.

branches.effect: return nil; other errors propagate to caller

units.does: Maps a TopoElevationService.ServiceError to user text: badResponse → logs the raw message and returns a translated generic; emptyTrack → 'no GPS track'; networkError → the inner error's localizedDescription.

branches.effect: log message, return 'unexpected response from the elevation service'

units.does: Writes the DEM gain/loss into the archived session (and rebuilds its analysis snapshot) via writeResmoothedElevation, then sets refreshedSession, posts the collector's archive-changed signal and clears the preview; shows 'Session not found in archive.' or 'Couldn't save: …' on failure.

branches.effect: elevResmoothError = 'Session not found in archive.', return

units.does: Snapshots the user's max HR / weight (UserSettingsBridge) and, via updateArchived, sets the archived workout's elevationGainMeters/LossMeters and rebuilds its analysisSnapshot from the updated session. Returns the stored session, or nil when it is not in the archive; rethrows archive errors.
Shows the α1 re-analysis card only when some sample has α1 and the session's RR series has >= 64 beats.
Card explaining that old sessions may have inflated α1 and offering regeneration with the current filter, with error note and button.
Button that runs runReanalyze in a Task; label 'Re-analysing…' and dimmed/disabled while running.

branches.effect: label 'Re-analysing…'; else 'Re-analyze α1 for this session'

units.does: Shows reanalyzeError in red when set.
Header 'Re-analyze α1' with spinner while running.
Sets the busy flag, recomputes α1 off-main and persists the refreshed samples; shows 'Not enough RR data to re-analyze.' when nothing came back.

branches.effect: reanalyzeError = 'Not enough RR data to re-analyze.', return; else persist

units.does: On a detached task, runs WorkoutAlpha1Reanalyzer.reanalyze on a session snapshot and, if it produced readings and the session has samples, applies them to the samples; returns (samples or nil, readings).

branches.effect: return (nil, readings) → caller shows 'Not enough RR data' even when the cause is missing samples

units.does: Writes the re-analysed samples (with α1-enriched splits and a rebuilt analysis snapshot) to the archive, then sets refreshedSession, clears the Alpha1StatsCache in the same main-actor turn (its key ignores α1 values) and posts the archive-changed signal; shows a save error or 'Session not found in archive.' on failure.

branches.effect: reanalyzeError = 'Session not found in archive.', return

units.does: Computes α1-enriched splits, snapshots max HR / weight (UserSettingsBridge) and, via updateArchived, replaces the archived workout's samples and (when computed) splits and rebuilds its analysisSnapshot from them.

branches.effect: stored splits replaced; nil → splits left unchanged

units.does: Returns WorkoutAnalyzer.splitsEnrichedWithAlpha1 on a copy of the session metadata with the new samples, or nil when there is no metadata or no splits.
Recap Card share button: tapping runs generateRecapCard in a Task; disabled while generating; presents a ShareSheet with the PNG file URL, or the UIImage if no URL.

branches.effect: share the image; neither → empty sheet content

units.does: Label row: spinner or stack icon, recap text, trailing share glyph when idle.
Title 'Building card…' while generating else 'Share Recap Card', with subtitle 'Vertical 9:16 — Instagram Story / Reels ready'.
File-scope header row: loop icon, 'On <route>' and 'vs your last N'.
File-scope pair of today value, '/', and baseline value.
File-scope helper: formats Celsius as rounded °F or °C per the unit.
File-scope helper: a sentence describing the heat-acclimatization stimulus: none when <= 0, 'strong' at >= 0.85, 'solid (N%)' at >= 0.5, otherwise 'mild (N%)'.

branches.effect: 'A solid heat stimulus (N%)…'; below → 'A mild heat stimulus (N%)…'

units.does: File-scope, nonisolated: builds WorkoutAnalysisSnapshotBuilder.Inputs from the session as it now stands (sport, duration, distance, elevation gain/loss, mean HR, samples, splits, Lucia TRIMP, decoupling) plus the given max HR / weight and replaces workoutMetadata.analysisSnapshot with the built snapshot. Leaves the old snapshot when there is no metadata, no samples or no duration. Kept outside FitnessSummaryCards so it can run inside the archive update closure and the type does not grow.

branches.cond: no workoutMetadata, samples nil/empty, or duration nil

flags.text: Builds the same WorkoutAnalysisSnapshotBuilder.Inputs from a session + UserSettingsBridge as FitnessPostSummaryView.snapshotInputs() in FitnessPostSummaryView+Feeling.swift; a change to the inputs has to be made in both.
